THE ELDER SCROLLS ONLINE

Windows - current live client, Update 50 / Season One as of 2026-08-06 · 65 areas · 2463 tracked items

This page shows everything, including exact locations. It exists so you can search for one specific collectible and find it. If you are playing blind, use the interactive spoiler-free version instead, it hides locations until you ask for them, one item at a time.

Record content access

Route setting

HintCheck Collections and Stories before choosing a region.
WhereList every owned chapter, downloadable region, dungeon pack, class, and account unlock; mark subscription access separately.

Create an all-class completion roster (missable)

Character plan

HintReserve character slots for class and decision coverage.
WhereKeep one character per playable class and alternates for incompatible quest states.
Full detailCreate all seven classes, preserve one principal world-completion character, and use alternates for exclusive choices because an online character state cannot be locally restored.

Complete Champion progression

Account progression

HintKeep earning account experience after the character cap.
WhereUnlock every Champion star and save legal slotted configurations in all disciplines.
Full detailEarn enough points for every passive and slottable star, test the maximum slots in each constellation, and save role builds in the Armory. The repeatable numeric ceiling is progression, not finite content.

Complete subclassing

Character system

HintTrain native lines before borrowing another class line.
WhereUnlock subclassing, collect every eligible borrowed line, and save legal configurations.
Full detailFinish the introduction, rank every class line on its native character, test every legal replacement and morph through respecs, and save damage, healing, and tank builds. Restore native lines for Class Mastery.

Complete Werewolf progression

World skill line

HintKeep a separate Armory state for transformation play.
WhereAcquire Werewolf and raise its refreshed skill line to maximum.

Auridon

You are here when: The named settlements, roads, ruins, caves, and activity icons within Auridon.

Route group: Aldmeri Dominion.

Complete the Auridon zone questline

Zone questline

HintFollow the local diamond-marked path before leaving the region.
WhereIn Auridon, clear every quest carrying the Zone Guide story marker.
Full detailOpen the Auridon Zone Guide and finish each displayed story segment plus any journal prerequisite. Recheck the guide after the final hand-in; use another character for an incompatible resolution.

Complete every side quest in Auridon

Local activity

HintInvestigate black quest arrows around roads and settlements.
WhereSweep every settlement, road junction, delve entrance, and discovered landmark in Auridon.
Full detailFinish every non-repeatable side quest in Auridon, then revisit cleared hubs for follow-ups. Complete each distinct daily variant once; its unique reward catalogue is tracked by the repeatable entry.

Complete the Auridon map

Map discovery

HintExplore gaps between unlocked travel points.
WhereTurn every unfinished Auridon icon white, including striking locales and special entrances.
Full detailEnter each icon's discovery radius and clear any objective that keeps it black. Reopen the Zone Guide until every permanent exploration category is filled; group instances remain separate checks.

Read every lorebook assigned to Auridon

Lorebook set

HintInspect readable objects near ruins, camps, desks, and roads.
WhereUse the Lore Library and Auridon map to identify every unread fixed book assigned here.
Full detailInteract with every counted book in Auridon. If a quest interior changes, locate its replacement copy in the open world and confirm the library entry rather than retaining a physical item.

Complete fishing in Auridon

Fishing collection

HintTry every local water type with suitable bait.
WhereCatch every named rare fish listed for Auridon across all water types present.
Full detailUse matching bait at each water type in Auridon; keep moving when a hole empties until every regional rare entry registers. Angler grouping and fishing passives only accelerate the process.

Collect every skyshard in Auridon

Skyshard set

HintWatch the skyline and interior side routes for a blue-white beam.
WhereClear the local skyshard counter in the Auridon Zone Guide, including instanced shards.
Full detailCollect all 16 shards assigned to Auridon. Use the verified landmark entries below, then the in-game clue for any unresolved shard; the set is done only when its local counter is full.

Skyshard, Vulkhel Guard

Skyshard

HintSearch the broader Auridon landscape and its marked interiors.
WhereThe shard belongs at Vulkhel Guard in Auridon; inspect that landmark and its adjoining path.
Full detailTravel to Vulkhel Guard, follow its accessible route to the beam, and interact until absorption completes. For a delve or public dungeon, search the interior rather than its exterior marker.

Skyshard, Valano Manor

Skyshard

HintSearch the broader Auridon landscape and its marked interiors.
WhereThe shard belongs at Valano Manor in Auridon; inspect that landmark and its adjoining path.
Full detailTravel to Valano Manor, follow its accessible route to the beam, and interact until absorption completes. For a delve or public dungeon, search the interior rather than its exterior marker.

The Rift

You are here when: The named settlements, roads, ruins, caves, and activity icons within The Rift.

Route group: Ebonheart Pact.

Complete the The Rift zone questline

Zone questline

HintFollow the local diamond-marked path before leaving the region.
WhereIn The Rift, clear every quest carrying the Zone Guide story marker.
Full detailOpen the The Rift Zone Guide and finish each displayed story segment plus any journal prerequisite. Recheck the guide after the final hand-in; use another character for an incompatible resolution.

Complete every side quest in The Rift

Local activity

HintInvestigate black quest arrows around roads and settlements.
WhereSweep every settlement, road junction, delve entrance, and discovered landmark in The Rift.
Full detailFinish every non-repeatable side quest in The Rift, then revisit cleared hubs for follow-ups. Complete each distinct daily variant once; its unique reward catalogue is tracked by the repeatable entry.

Complete the The Rift map

Map discovery

HintExplore gaps between unlocked travel points.
WhereTurn every unfinished The Rift icon white, including striking locales and special entrances.
Full detailEnter each icon's discovery radius and clear any objective that keeps it black. Reopen the Zone Guide until every permanent exploration category is filled; group instances remain separate checks.

Read every lorebook assigned to The Rift

Lorebook set

HintInspect readable objects near ruins, camps, desks, and roads.
WhereUse the Lore Library and The Rift map to identify every unread fixed book assigned here.
Full detailInteract with every counted book in The Rift. If a quest interior changes, locate its replacement copy in the open world and confirm the library entry rather than retaining a physical item.

Complete fishing in The Rift

Fishing collection

HintTry every local water type with suitable bait.
WhereCatch every named rare fish listed for The Rift across all water types present.

Cyrodiil

You are here when: The named settlements, roads, ruins, caves, and activity icons within Cyrodiil.

Route group: Neutral and Disputed.

Complete the Cyrodiil zone questline

Zone questline

HintFollow the local diamond-marked path before leaving the region.
WhereIn Cyrodiil, clear every quest carrying the Zone Guide story marker.
Full detailOpen the Cyrodiil Zone Guide and finish each displayed story segment plus any journal prerequisite. Recheck the guide after the final hand-in; use another character for an incompatible resolution.

Complete every side quest in Cyrodiil

Local activity

HintInvestigate black quest arrows around roads and settlements.
WhereSweep every settlement, road junction, delve entrance, and discovered landmark in Cyrodiil.
Full detailFinish every non-repeatable side quest in Cyrodiil, then revisit cleared hubs for follow-ups. Complete each distinct daily variant once; its unique reward catalogue is tracked by the repeatable entry.

Complete the Cyrodiil map

Map discovery

HintExplore gaps between unlocked travel points.
WhereTurn every unfinished Cyrodiil icon white, including striking locales and special entrances.
Full detailEnter each icon's discovery radius and clear any objective that keeps it black. Reopen the Zone Guide until every permanent exploration category is filled; group instances remain separate checks.

Read every lorebook assigned to Cyrodiil

Lorebook set

HintInspect readable objects near ruins, camps, desks, and roads.
WhereUse the Lore Library and Cyrodiil map to identify every unread fixed book assigned here.
Full detailInteract with every counted book in Cyrodiil. If a quest interior changes, locate its replacement copy in the open world and confirm the library entry rather than retaining a physical item.

Complete fishing in Cyrodiil

Fishing collection

HintTry every local water type with suitable bait.
WhereCatch every named rare fish listed for Cyrodiil across all water types present.
Full detailUse matching bait at each water type in Cyrodiil; keep moving when a hole empties until every regional rare entry registers. Angler grouping and fishing passives only accelerate the process.

Northern Elsweyr

Complete the Northern Elsweyr zone questline

Zone questline

HintFollow the local diamond-marked path before leaving the region.
WhereIn Northern Elsweyr, clear every quest carrying the Zone Guide story marker.
Full detailOpen the Northern Elsweyr Zone Guide and finish each displayed story segment plus any journal prerequisite. Recheck the guide after the final hand-in; use another character for an incompatible resolution.

Complete every side quest in Northern Elsweyr

Local activity

HintInvestigate black quest arrows around roads and settlements.
WhereSweep every settlement, road junction, delve entrance, and discovered landmark in Northern Elsweyr.
Full detailFinish every non-repeatable side quest in Northern Elsweyr, then revisit cleared hubs for follow-ups. Complete each distinct daily variant once; its unique reward catalogue is tracked by the repeatable entry.

Complete the Northern Elsweyr map

Map discovery

HintExplore gaps between unlocked travel points.
WhereTurn every unfinished Northern Elsweyr icon white, including striking locales and special entrances.
Full detailEnter each icon's discovery radius and clear any objective that keeps it black. Reopen the Zone Guide until every permanent exploration category is filled; group instances remain separate checks.

Read every lorebook assigned to Northern Elsweyr

Lorebook set

HintInspect readable objects near ruins, camps, desks, and roads.
WhereUse the Lore Library and Northern Elsweyr map to identify every unread fixed book assigned here.
Full detailInteract with every counted book in Northern Elsweyr. If a quest interior changes, locate its replacement copy in the open world and confirm the library entry rather than retaining a physical item.

Complete fishing in Northern Elsweyr

Fishing collection

HintTry every local water type with suitable bait.
WhereCatch every named rare fish listed for Northern Elsweyr across all water types present.
Full detailUse matching bait at each water type in Northern Elsweyr; keep moving when a hole empties until every regional rare entry registers. Angler grouping and fishing passives only accelerate the process.

Telvanni Peninsula

You are here when: The named settlements, roads, ruins, caves, and activity icons within Telvanni Peninsula.

Route group: Chapter Zones.

Complete the Telvanni Peninsula zone questline

Zone questline

HintFollow the local diamond-marked path before leaving the region.
WhereIn Telvanni Peninsula, clear every quest carrying the Zone Guide story marker.
Full detailOpen the Telvanni Peninsula Zone Guide and finish each displayed story segment plus any journal prerequisite. Recheck the guide after the final hand-in; use another character for an incompatible resolution.

Complete every side quest in Telvanni Peninsula

Local activity

HintInvestigate black quest arrows around roads and settlements.
WhereSweep every settlement, road junction, delve entrance, and discovered landmark in Telvanni Peninsula.
Full detailFinish every non-repeatable side quest in Telvanni Peninsula, then revisit cleared hubs for follow-ups. Complete each distinct daily variant once; its unique reward catalogue is tracked by the repeatable entry.

Complete the Telvanni Peninsula map

Map discovery

HintExplore gaps between unlocked travel points.
WhereTurn every unfinished Telvanni Peninsula icon white, including striking locales and special entrances.
Full detailEnter each icon's discovery radius and clear any objective that keeps it black. Reopen the Zone Guide until every permanent exploration category is filled; group instances remain separate checks.

Read every lorebook assigned to Telvanni Peninsula

Lorebook set

HintInspect readable objects near ruins, camps, desks, and roads.
WhereUse the Lore Library and Telvanni Peninsula map to identify every unread fixed book assigned here.
Full detailInteract with every counted book in Telvanni Peninsula. If a quest interior changes, locate its replacement copy in the open world and confirm the library entry rather than retaining a physical item.

Complete fishing in Telvanni Peninsula

Fishing collection

HintTry every local water type with suitable bait.
WhereCatch every named rare fish listed for Telvanni Peninsula across all water types present.
Full detailUse matching bait at each water type in Telvanni Peninsula; keep moving when a hole empties until every regional rare entry registers. Angler grouping and fishing passives only accelerate the process.

Crafting, Research, Recipes, and Motifs

You are here when: Crafting hubs, writ boards, set stations, traders, regional coffers, and knowledge menus.

Research every equipment trait

Crafting research

HintKeep every research slot running and save unknown traits.
WhereResearch all nine traits on every craftable weapon, armor, and jewelry type.
Full detailConsume one item for every missing trait, reduce timers with passives or scrolls, and continue until every research row shows nine. Preserve scarce Nirnhoned and jewelry examples for ready slots.

Master every crafting profession

Crafting profession

HintDeconstruct unfamiliar gear and certify each discipline.
WhereMax Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Clothing, Enchanting, Jewelry, Provisioning, and Woodworking.
Full detailFinish certifications; buy every material, extraction, and improvement passive; learn all reagent and rune effects; complete top-tier daily writs and one master writ for each applicable profession.

Learn every obtainable recipe and furnishing plan

Recipe catalogue

HintSearch containers and rotate regional, event, and voucher vendors.
WhereClear every obtainable food, drink, formula, blueprint, diagram, pattern, praxis, design, and sketch entry.
Full detailRead every unlearned plan, confirm it at the correct station, buy permanent voucher plans, and farm active regional or event sources. Retired and store-only plans stay in the availability ledger.

Use every set-crafting station

Crafting discovery

HintInvestigate special workbenches in completed regions.
WhereVisit each permanent crafted-set site and meet its trait threshold.
Full detailActivate every profession bench at each crafted-set location, make one valid piece per set, and verify reconstructable or attunable access where owned.

Antiquity catalogue

Set collection

HintBind new pieces before selling or deconstructing them.
WhereFill all current overland, dungeon, trial, arena, PvP, and special set pages.

Complete every zone museum and fragment display

Museum collection

WhereFinish every permanent museum, tapestry, relic, instrument, mural, and multi-piece region collection.

Account collection

Housing system
